name: feature-library-scout
description: Research and recommend vetted libraries per feature problem (lists, camera, forms, keyboard, sheets), ranked by adoption signal, writing FEATURE_LIBRARIES.md from captured REFERENCES.md sources. Use when the stack is chosen and you want per-feature libraries vetted. Do not use to pick stack layers (use stack-recommend), check framework patterns (use stack-currency-check), synthesize captured sources (use external-research), or without a task (run task-init first). For more than 3 feature problems needing a deep sweep, use feature-library-scout-fleet.
